desc.en: Ten short programs about the things Python does before it does anything else: reading a line, holding it in a variable, converting between int, float and str, and printing the result in a readable shape. Every program can be read with line numbers, syntax highlighting and per-line notes; fill-in mode blanks out the lines that carry the idea and tells you which token is wrong; trace mode puts a shadow of the source under your cursor so you type it out character by character. Two problems - largest of three, and swapping two variables - come in two versions each, so you can put the obvious way next to the Python way and see the difference rather than be told it.
desc.zh: 十个短程序，讲的是 Python 在做任何别的事情之前先做的那几件事：读进一行、把它存在变量里、在 int / float / str 之间转换、再把结果打印成看得懂的形状。每个程序都可以带行号、高亮和逐行讲解地读；挖空模式把承载想法的那几行挖掉，填错时告诉你是第几个 token 不同；临摹模式在光标底下垫一层源码的影子，让你逐字敲出来。其中「三数取大」与「交换两数」各有两个写法，把想当然的那一种和 Python 的那一种并排摆着——差别是看出来的，不是被告知的。

tag.en: input() is always str · f-strings · swap without a temp · read / fill in / trace
tag.zh: input() 永远是 str · f-string · 不用临时变量的交换 · 读 / 挖空 / 临摹

changelog.en: Every program now has at least one blank to fill in - seven of the ten had none, so fill-in mode had nothing to do on them. Hints split into tiers more reliably: a semicolon inside a hint no longer cuts it short. The side panel now opens with each program's level, kind, line and blank counts, exam boards and tags, and decorators get their own colour. Count Vowels now adds one with the += idiom.
changelog.zh: 每个程序都至少有一个空了——十个程序里原先有七个一个空都没有，挖空模式下无事可做。提示分级更可靠：提示里的分号不会再把后半句截掉。右侧面板顶部显示每个程序的难度、类型、行数与空数、考试局和标签；装饰器有了自己的颜色。「数元音」改用 += 惯用写法加一。

changelog.en: First release: the ten Language Foundations programs, with all three modes - read, fill in the blanks, and shadow tracing. Two problems ship in two variants each for side-by-side comparison.
changelog.zh: 首发：第一模块「语言基础」的十个程序，三种模式全开——读、挖空、影子临摹。其中两个问题各带两个写法，可并排对照。

desc.en: Twelve programs about the type every program handles most: indexing and slicing, why a string can never be changed in place, the everyday methods, splitting and joining, and the escape sequences and raw strings that make backslashes behave. Then the classic string problems an A-level paper expects you to write by hand - reversing a string, testing a palindrome, a Caesar cipher, converting binary to denary, and checking a password against a set of rules. Reversing and binary conversion each come in two versions, the built-in one next to the algorithm it hides, so the difference is something you see rather than something you are told.
desc.zh: 十二个程序，讲每个程序打交道最多的那个类型：下标与切片、字符串为什么永远不能原地修改、天天用的那些方法、切开与粘合、以及让反斜杠听话的转义与原始字符串。然后是 A-level 卷子要你手写的那几道经典字符串题——反转字符串、判断回文、凯撒密码、二进制转十进制、按一组规则检查密码。反转与进制转换各有两个写法，内置函数那一版和它藏起来的算法并排摆着——差别是看出来的，不是被告知的。

tag.en: slices · immutable str · split / join · escapes · Caesar · binary · read / fill in / trace
tag.zh: 切片 · str 不可变 · split / join · 转义 · 凯撒 · 二进制 · 读 / 挖空 / 临摹

changelog.en: First release: twelve string programs with all three modes - read, fill in the blanks, and shadow tracing. Reversing a string and binary-to-denary ship in two variants each for side-by-side comparison.
changelog.zh: 首发：十二个字符串程序，三种模式全开——读、挖空、影子临摹。「反转字符串」与「二进制转十进制」各带两个写法，可并排对照。

desc.en: Twelve programs about writing your own functions and calling them: parameters and arguments, return versus print, defaults and keyword arguments, *args and **kwargs, returning several values at once, local and global names, functions passed around as values, docstrings and type hints, and splitting one job into small testable functions. Two versions of the same list-building function sit side by side - one with a shared default list that quietly keeps growing across calls, one with the None fix - so the trap is something you watch happen in the output rather than a rule you are told.
desc.zh: 十二个程序，讲怎样自己写函数、怎样调用：形参与实参、return 与 print 之别、默认值与关键字实参、*args 与 **kwargs、一次返回多个值、局部与全局名字、把函数当值传来传去、文档串与类型注解，以及把一件事拆成几个能单独测试的小函数。同一个往列表里加东西的函数有两个写法并排摆着——一个用共享的默认列表、跨调用悄悄越变越长，一个用 None 修好——这个陷阱是你在输出里亲眼看着发生的，不是被告知的一条规矩。

tag.en: return vs print · the mutable default trap · *args / **kwargs · read / fill in / trace
tag.zh: return 与 print · 可变默认值陷阱 · *args / **kwargs · 读 / 挖空 / 临摹

changelog.en: First release: twelve programs on functions, with all three modes - read, fill in the blanks, and shadow tracing. The shared-default-list trap and its None fix ship as a pair for side-by-side comparison.
changelog.zh: 首发：十二个关于函数的程序，三种模式全开——读、挖空、影子临摹。共享默认列表的陷阱与 None 修法成对提供，可并排对照。

desc.en: Twelve short programs on object-oriented Python, from a first class with __init__ and self through to abstract base classes. Along the way: __str__ versus __repr__, a class attribute shared on purpose next to a list shared by accident, a bank account that guards its own balance, inheritance with super(), polymorphism with and without a common parent, composition, operator overloading, and a second constructor built with a class method. Read each program with per-line notes, fill in the lines that carry the idea, or trace it character by character. One problem - a 2D point - comes twice, written by hand and as a dataclass, so you can see exactly what the decorator writes for you.
desc.zh: 十二个短程序讲 Python 的面向对象，从第一个带 __init__ 和 self 的类，一直讲到抽象基类。一路上还有：__str__ 与 __repr__ 之别、一个有意共用的类属性旁边摆着一张无意中共用的列表、一个自己看守余额的银行账户、带 super() 的继承、有共同父类与没有共同父类的多态、组合、运算符重载，以及用类方法写的备用构造器。每个程序都可以带逐行讲解地读、把承载想法的那几行挖掉来填、或者逐字临摹。其中「二维点」出现两次——手写一遍、dataclass 一遍——好看清装饰器到底替你写了什么。

tag.en: self and __init__ · str vs repr · inheritance & super() · duck typing · dataclass · read / fill in / trace
tag.zh: self 与 __init__ · str 与 repr · 继承与 super() · 鸭子类型 · dataclass · 读 / 挖空 / 临摹

changelog.en: First release: twelve Classes & Objects programs with all three modes - read, fill in the blanks, and shadow tracing. The point-class problem ships in two variants (hand-written and dataclass) for side-by-side comparison.
changelog.zh: 首发：「类与对象」十二个程序，三种模式全开——读、挖空、影子临摹。「二维点」一题带两个写法（手写 / dataclass），可并排对照。

desc.en: Twelve short programs about what happens at the edges of a program: reading and writing text files, reading a CSV by hand and with the csv module, writing one with DictWriter, and every part of Python's exception handling - the order try, except, else and finally run in, several except clauses, raising ValueError for bad input, your own exception classes, and a loop that keeps asking until the input is valid. Two problems come in two versions each: reading a CSV (split by hand against the csv module) and a file that might be missing (try it and catch the error, against checking first), so the two approaches sit side by side. Every program can be read with per-line notes, filled in blank by blank, or traced character by character.
desc.zh: 十二个短程序，讲的是程序边缘上发生的事：读写文本文件、手工与用 csv 模块两种方式读 CSV、用 DictWriter 写 CSV，以及 Python 异常处理的每一部分——try、except、else、finally 的执行顺序，多个 except 子句，对不合法的输入 raise ValueError，自定义异常类，还有一个输入不合法就一直问下去的循环。其中两个问题各有两个写法：读 CSV（手工 split 对 csv 模块）与可能不存在的文件（先做再接住错误，对先检查再做），两种思路并排摆着。每个程序都可以带逐行讲解地读、逐空填写，或逐字临摹。

tag.en: with open · csv · try / except / else / finally · raise · custom exceptions · read / fill in / trace
tag.zh: with open · csv · try / except / else / finally · raise · 自定义异常 · 读 / 挖空 / 临摹

changelog.en: Four programs that read a data file (read-csv-split, read-csv-module, missing-file-eafp, missing-file-lbyl) now list the file's contents one line per paragraph in the notes, so they can be copied straight into _fixtures/ in PyCharm; a new gate keeps those lines identical to the real file.
changelog.zh: 读数据文件的四个程序（read-csv-split、read-csv-module、missing-file-eafp、missing-file-lbyl）讲解里把文件内容改成一段一行，可以照抄进 PyCharm 的 _fixtures/；新增一道门守住这几行与真文件一致。

changelog.en: First release: twelve programs on files and exceptions, with all three modes - read, fill in the blanks, and shadow tracing. Reading a CSV and handling a missing file each ship in two variants for side-by-side comparison.
changelog.zh: 首发：「文件与异常」十二个程序，三种模式全开——读、挖空、影子临摹。「读 CSV」与「文件不存在」各带两个写法，可并排对照。

desc.en: Twelve short programs about how a program decides: which values count as true, and and or that hand back an operand and stop early, the conditional expression, elif chains and chained comparisons, the triangle inequality as a guard clause, rock-paper-scissors decided with one remainder, a truth table that checks De Morgan's laws, and match / case for reading typed commands (Python 3.10 or later). Three problems come in two versions each - grade boundaries (an elif chain that depends on its order, against whole ranges that do not), the leap-year rule (nested ifs against one boolean expression) and a ticket price (nested conditions against guard clauses) - so the two approaches sit side by side. Every program can be read with per-line notes, filled in blank by blank, or traced character by character.
desc.zh: 十二个短程序，讲程序怎样做决定：哪些值算真、交回操作数并且提前停下的 and 与 or、条件表达式、elif 链与链式比较、当守卫子句用的三角不等式、用一次取余判定的石头剪刀布、验证德摩根律的真值表，以及读取输入命令的 match / case（需要 Python 3.10 或更高）。其中三个问题各有两个写法——成绩等级（依赖书写顺序的 elif 链，对与顺序无关的完整区间）、闰年规则（嵌套 if，对一个布尔表达式）与票价（嵌套条件，对守卫子句），两种思路并排摆着。每个程序都可以带逐行讲解地读、逐空填写，或逐字临摹。

tag.en: if / elif / else · truthiness · and / or / not · guard clauses · match / case · read / fill in / trace
tag.zh: if / elif / else · 真值 · and / or / not · 守卫子句 · match / case · 读 / 挖空 / 临摹

changelog.en: First release: twelve programs on conditionals, with all three modes - read, fill in the blanks, and shadow tracing. Grade boundaries, the leap-year rule and ticket prices each ship in two variants for side-by-side comparison.
changelog.zh: 首发：「条件判断」十二个程序，三种模式全开——读、挖空、影子临摹。「成绩等级」「闰年」「票价」各带两个写法，可并排对照。

desc.en: Twelve short programs about repeating things: every shape of range(), a while loop that reads numbers until a sentinel, skipping with continue and stopping with break, finding the largest value and where it is, a loop capped at a number of tries with while...else, and why FizzBuzz has to test for both first. Three problems come in two versions each - has a negative (a flag against for...else), digit sum (% 10 against a string) and pair sum (every pair against two pointers on a sorted list) - so the two approaches sit side by side. Every program can be read with per-line notes, filled in blank by blank, or traced character by character.
desc.zh: 十二个短程序，讲的是「重复」：range() 的各种写法、读到哨兵为止的 while 循环、continue 跳过与 break 停下、找最大值及其位置、带次数上限的 while…else，以及 FizzBuzz 为什么必须先判「两者都是」。其中三个问题各有两个写法——有没有负数（标志位对 for…else）、数位和（% 10 对字符串）、两数之和（每一对都试对有序列表上的双指针）——两种思路并排摆着。每个程序都可以带逐行讲解地读、逐空填写，或逐字临摹。

tag.en: range · while · break / continue · flags · for...else · nested loops · two pointers · read / fill in / trace
tag.zh: range · while · break / continue · 标志位 · for…else · 嵌套循环 · 双指针 · 读 / 挖空 / 临摹

changelog.en: First release: twelve programs on loops, with all three modes - read, fill in the blanks, and shadow tracing. Has a negative, digit sum and pair sum each ship in two variants for side-by-side comparison.
changelog.zh: 首发：「循环」十二个程序，三种模式全开——读、挖空、影子临摹。「有没有负数」「数位和」「两数之和」各带两个写法，可并排对照。

desc.en: Twelve short programs about writing loops that build things more compactly - and knowing when not to: list comprehensions with and without an if, dictionary and set comprehensions, nested comprehensions that flatten and transpose a grid, generator expressions with sum, any and all, and the built-ins that replace hand-written loops - enumerate, zip, map, filter, and sorted, min and max with key=. Two problems come in two versions each: a list of squares (loop and append against a comprehension) and keeping the even numbers (a comprehension with if against filter), so the two approaches sit side by side. Every program can be read with per-line notes, filled in blank by blank, or traced character by character.
desc.zh: 十二个短程序，讲怎样把「造东西的循环」写得更紧凑——以及什么时候不该这样写：带与不带 if 的列表推导式、字典与集合推导式、展平与转置网格的嵌套推导式、配 sum / any / all 的生成器表达式，以及替代手写循环的内置函数——enumerate、zip、map、filter，还有带 key= 的 sorted、min、max。其中两个问题各有两个写法：平方表（循环加 append 对推导式）与只留偶数（带 if 的推导式对 filter），两种思路并排摆着。每个程序都可以带逐行讲解地读、逐空填写，或逐字临摹。

tag.en: comprehensions · generator expressions · enumerate · zip · map · filter · sorted key= · read / fill in / trace
tag.zh: 推导式 · 生成器表达式 · enumerate · zip · map · filter · sorted key= · 读 / 挖空 / 临摹

changelog.en: First release: twelve programs on comprehensions and the built-ins that go with them, with all three modes - read, fill in the blanks, and shadow tracing. Squares and keeping the evens each ship in two variants for side-by-side comparison.
changelog.zh: 首发：「推导式与内置函数」十二个程序，三种模式全开——读、挖空、影子临摹。「平方表」与「只留偶数」各带两个写法，可并排对照。

desc.en: Twelve programs about functions that call themselves. It starts with the two parts every recursive function needs - a base case that stops and a step that makes the problem smaller - and with the call stack itself, printed as indented enter and leave lines, up to the RecursionError you get when nothing ever stops. Then the same problems solved more than one way: factorial by recursion and by a loop; Fibonacci four ways, from the naive version whose call count explodes to a hand-written memo dictionary, functools.lru_cache and two rolling variables; and powers by stepping down one at a time or by halving. The classic recursive algorithms finish the page: the Towers of Hanoi, every permutation of a string, and flattening a list nested to any depth.
desc.zh: 十二个程序，讲调用自己的函数。先讲每个递归函数都少不了的两部分——让它停下的基例、让问题变小的递归步——再把调用栈本身打印出来：按深度缩进的进入 / 离开两行，一直到什么都停不下来时撞上的 RecursionError。然后是同一个问题的几种解法：阶乘用递归与用循环；斐波那契四种，从调用次数爆炸的朴素版，到手写字典记忆化、functools.lru_cache、两个变量滚动；求幂一次减一与一次折半。最后是几道经典递归算法：汉诺塔、字符串的全排列、展平任意深度的嵌套列表。

tag.en: base case · call stack · memoisation · lru_cache · Hanoi · permutations · read / fill in / trace
tag.zh: 基例 · 调用栈 · 记忆化 · lru_cache · 汉诺塔 · 全排列 · 读 / 挖空 / 临摹

changelog.en: First release: twelve recursion programs with all three modes - read, fill in the blanks, and shadow tracing. Factorial comes in two variants, power in two and Fibonacci in four, for side-by-side comparison.
changelog.zh: 首发：十二个递归程序，三种模式全开——读、挖空、影子临摹。阶乘与求幂各带两个写法、斐波那契带四个写法，可并排对照。

desc.en: Twelve programs on the list as a data structure. It starts with the everyday methods - append, insert and extend, pop by position and remove by value, del, index and in - and with slice assignment, which can replace, insert or delete a whole stretch at once. Then what a copy really is: a second name for the same list, a shallow copy whose rows are still shared, and a deep copy that shares nothing, followed by the grid whose rows are secretly one list. Tables come next: row and column totals with nested index loops, and matrix multiplication two ways, by three index loops and by rows times zip-ed columns. The page ends with rotating a list by slices or by pop and append, and with the loop that skips items because it removes while it iterates.
desc.zh: 十二个程序，把列表当作数据结构来讲。先是日常方法——append、insert 与 extend，按位置 pop、按值 remove，del、index 与 in——以及切片赋值：一次替换、插入或删除一整段。然后讲拷贝到底是什么：同一个列表的第二个名字、各行仍然共用的浅拷贝、什么都不共用的深拷贝，外加一张各行其实是同一个列表的网格。接着是二维表：用两重下标循环求行合计与列合计，矩阵乘法两种写法——三重下标循环，和行乘以 zip 取出的列。最后是列表旋转（两段切片，或 pop 再 append），以及一边遍历一边删除、因而跳过元素的那个循环。

tag.en: list methods · slice assignment · alias / shallow / deep copy · 2D lists · matrix multiply · rotation · read / fill in / trace
tag.zh: 列表方法 · 切片赋值 · 别名 / 浅拷贝 / 深拷贝 · 二维列表 · 矩阵乘法 · 旋转 · 读 / 挖空 / 临摹

changelog.en: First release: twelve list programs with all three modes - read, fill in the blanks, and shadow tracing. Copying a list comes in three variants, and matrix multiplication and list rotation in two each, for side-by-side comparison.
changelog.zh: 首发：十二个列表程序，三种模式全开——读、挖空、影子临摹。拷贝列表带三个写法，矩阵乘法与列表旋转各带两个写法，可并排对照。

desc.en: Twelve programs about dictionaries and sets. It opens with the whole life of a dictionary entry - reading with square brackets and the KeyError you get for a missing key, reading gently with get, in checking keys, assignment that adds or updates, del and pop, and iterating in insertion order. Then the same problems solved more than one way: counting words with an in test, with get and a default, and with collections.Counter; grouping words by first letter with setdefault and with defaultdict; and removing duplicates while keeping the order, with a seen set and with dict.fromkeys. A Roman-numeral lookup table, set algebra on two club rosters, tuple keys for a sparse grid and an anagram check by counting letters finish the page.
desc.zh: 十二个程序，讲字典与集合。先把字典里一项的一生走一遍：方括号取值与键不存在时的 KeyError、温和的 get、in 查的是键、赋值即新增或更新、del 与 pop、按插入顺序遍历。然后是同一个问题的几种解法：词频统计用 in 判断、用 get 带缺省值、用 collections.Counter；按首字母分组用 setdefault 与 defaultdict；保序去重用 seen 集合与 dict.fromkeys。最后是查表读罗马数字、两个社团名单的集合运算、元组作键存稀疏网格、数字母判变位词。

tag.en: dict · get · Counter · defaultdict · set algebra · tuple keys · read / fill in / trace
tag.zh: 字典 · get · Counter · defaultdict · 集合运算 · 元组作键 · 读 / 挖空 / 临摹

changelog.en: First release: twelve dictionary and set programs with all three modes - read, fill in the blanks, and shadow tracing. Word counting comes in three variants, grouping by key and order-keeping de-duplication in two each, for side-by-side comparison.
changelog.zh: 首发：十二个字典与集合程序，三种模式全开——读、挖空、影子临摹。词频统计带三个写法、按键分组与保序去重各带两个写法，可并排对照。

desc.en: Eleven programs about the two structures that decide what comes out next. Stacks first: a plain list as a stack, then the exam-paper version - a fixed array with a top pointer that reports overflow and underflow. Then what stacks are for: matching brackets, evaluating Reverse Polish Notation, and turning ordinary infix into RPN with the shunting-yard algorithm. Queues next: hot potato solved with a list and with collections.deque, a circular queue whose pointers wrap round a fixed array, and a deque used at both ends and as a recent-history list. Two programs combine stacks: undo and redo in an editor, and a first-in, first-out queue built from two last-in, first-out stacks.
desc.zh: 十一个程序，讲决定「下一个出来的是谁」的两种结构。先是栈：普通列表当栈，再是考卷上的写法——定长数组加栈顶指针，上溢与下溢各报一句。然后是栈的用处：括号配对、逆波兰表达式求值、用调度场算法把平常的中缀式转成逆波兰。接着是队列：传土豆分别用列表与 collections.deque 来做，指针在定长数组里绕圈的循环队列，两头进出、兼做最近浏览记录的双端队列。最后两个程序把栈组合起来：编辑器的撤销与重做，以及用两个后进先出的栈拼出一个先进先出的队列。

tag.en: LIFO · FIFO · top pointer · brackets · RPN · shunting yard · circular queue · deque · read / fill in / trace
tag.zh: 后进先出 · 先进先出 · 栈顶指针 · 括号配对 · 逆波兰 · 调度场 · 循环队列 · 双端队列 · 读 / 挖空 / 临摹

changelog.en: First release: eleven stack and queue programs with all three modes - read, fill in the blanks, and shadow tracing. Hot potato comes in two variants, a list and a deque, for side-by-side comparison.
changelog.zh: 首发：十一个栈与队列程序，三种模式全开——读、挖空、影子临摹。传土豆带列表与双端队列两个写法，可并排对照。

desc.en: Ten programs about chains of nodes joined by references. It starts with a node class, three nodes linked by hand and the walk from the head to None; then the two operations that are all about pointers - inserting at position i, where the new node is linked to what follows before anything is linked to it, and deleting by value with a second pointer one step behind. A linked list is reversed two ways, with three pointers in a loop and recursively, for side-by-side comparison. Then the variations: a doubly linked list with a sentinel node, walked both ways; a stack whose top is the head of the list; the exam-style list kept in two parallel arrays with a free list of unused cells; and a linked list that works with for, list() and in through __iter__ written with yield, and with len() through __len__. The page ends by counting the steps a linked list takes to reach item i, against a Python list.
desc.zh: 十个程序，讲用引用连成一串的节点。先是节点类、手工连起来的三个节点、从头一直走到 None；然后是两种全靠指针的操作——在第 i 位插入（先接后面、再接前面），按值删除（第二个指针落后一步跟着）。反转链表有两种写法——循环里的三指针与递归——可并排对照。接着是几种变形：带哨兵节点、两头都能走的双向链表；以链表头为栈顶的栈；考卷风格、用两个平行数组加空闲链存放的链表；以及用 yield 写 __iter__、从而能用 for、list() 和 in，再写 __len__、从而能用 len() 的链表。最后数一数链表走到第 i 项要几步，与 Python 列表对比。

tag.en: nodes · pointers · insert / delete · reverse · doubly linked · free list · yield · read / fill in / trace
tag.zh: 节点 · 指针 · 插入 / 删除 · 反转 · 双向链表 · 空闲链 · yield · 读 / 挖空 / 临摹

changelog.en: First release: ten linked-list programs with all three modes - read, fill in the blanks, and shadow tracing. Reversing a linked list comes in two variants, iterative and recursive, for side-by-side comparison.
changelog.zh: 首发：十个链表程序，三种模式全开——读、挖空、影子临摹。反转链表带迭代与递归两个写法，可并排对照。

desc.en: Twelve programs about trees and heaps. It starts with a binary tree wired together by hand and two recursive functions that count its nodes and measure its height, then walks a binary search tree in preorder, inorder and postorder - recursively, and with an explicit stack. Insert comes two ways, by recursion and by a loop that keeps hold of the parent; search throws away a subtree at every step; delete handles a leaf, one child and two children with the inorder successor. The exam-paper layout stores a tree in three parallel arrays with -1 as the null pointer. A min-heap is written by hand in a list with sift up and sift down, and priority queues come two ways, on heapq with a (priority, seq, task) tuple and on a plain list scanned for the smallest. An expression tree built from reverse Polish notation finishes the page, evaluated and printed recursively.
desc.zh: 十二个程序，讲树与堆。先手工连起一棵二叉树，用两个递归函数数出它的节点、量出它的高度；再按前序、中序、后序走一棵二叉搜索树——递归写一遍，显式栈写一遍。插入有两种写法：递归，以及记住父节点的循环；查找每一步丢掉一棵子树；删除分叶子、单孩子、双孩子三种情形，双孩子用中序后继。考卷式存法把树放进三个平行数组，-1 当空指针。最小堆在列表里手写上浮与下沉；优先队列两种写法：heapq 配 (priority, seq, task) 元组，以及每次扫描取最小的普通列表。最后由逆波兰记号建一棵表达式树，递归求值、带括号打印。

tag.zh: 二叉搜索树 · 遍历 · 插入 / 查找 / 删除 · 最小堆 · heapq · 优先队列 · 表达式树 · 读 / 挖空 / 临摹

changelog.en: First release: twelve tree and heap programs with all three modes - read, fill in the blanks, and shadow tracing. Tree traversals, BST insert and the priority queue each come in two variants for side-by-side comparison.
changelog.zh: 首发：十二个树与堆的程序，三种模式全开——读、挖空、影子临摹。树的遍历、BST 插入与优先队列各带两个写法，可并排对照。

desc.en: Ten programs about finding a value. Linear search three ways: a for loop that only says "not here" after the whole list, a sentinel placed on a copy so the loop needs no end check, and an early exit in a sorted list. Binary search three ways - a loop over a closed range, recursion with the range passed down, and bisect_left from the standard library - then finding the first of several copies with a half-open range, counting a value with two binary searches, and the exam-style trace table of lo, mid and hi. The page ends with a hash table built by hand: key % SIZE, collisions and linear probing.
desc.zh: 十个程序，讲怎么找到一个值。线性查找三种：整张表看完才说「不在」的 for 循环、把哨兵放在副本上省掉越界判断、有序表里提前停。二分查找三种——闭区间的循环、把区间往下传的递归、标准库的 bisect_left——接着是半开区间找第一个副本、两次二分数出现次数、考卷上的 lo / mid / hi 追踪表。最后自己动手建一张哈希表：key % SIZE、冲突与线性探测。

tag.en: linear · sentinel · binary search · bisect · trace table · hashing · read / fill in / trace
tag.zh: 线性 · 哨兵 · 二分 · bisect · 追踪表 · 哈希 · 读 / 挖空 / 临摹

changelog.en: First release: ten searching programs with all three modes - read, fill in the blanks, and shadow tracing. Linear search and binary search each come in three variants for side-by-side comparison.
changelog.zh: 首发：十个查找程序，三种模式全开——读、挖空、影子临摹。线性查找与二分查找各带三个写法，可并排对照。

desc.en: Eleven sorting programs, each written by hand. Bubble sort twice - the plain version and one that stops early and shortens every pass - then selection sort, insertion sort with its saved key and shifts, and shell sort, which is insertion sort over shrinking gaps. Merge sort top down by recursion and bottom up by doubling widths, sharing one merge; quicksort in place with a Lomuto partition and again with three comprehensions; counting sort, which compares nothing. The in-place sorts return None like list.sort(), with a three-line sorted_copy that keeps the promise of sorted(). A last program sorts the same records with insertion and selection sort to show which one is stable, and why.
desc.zh: 十一个手写的排序程序。冒泡排序两种——朴素版，以及提前收工、每趟少比一个的那版；然后是选择排序、先存 key 再右移的插入排序，以及在逐次减半的间隔上做插入排序的希尔排序。归并排序自顶向下用递归、自底向上让宽度翻倍，共用同一个 merge；快速排序一版用 Lomuto 分区原地排，一版用三个推导式；计数排序则什么都不比。原地排序像 list.sort() 一样返回 None，另配三行的 sorted_copy 守 sorted() 的约定。最后一个程序用插入排序和选择排序排同一组记录，看哪一种稳定、为什么。

tag.en: bubble · insertion · merge · quicksort · counting · stability · read / fill in / trace
tag.zh: 冒泡 · 插入 · 归并 · 快排 · 计数 · 稳定性 · 读 / 挖空 / 临摹

changelog.en: First release: eleven sorting programs with all three modes - read, fill in the blanks, and shadow tracing. Bubble sort, merge sort and quicksort each come in two variants for side-by-side comparison.
changelog.zh: 首发：十一个排序程序，三种模式全开——读、挖空、影子临摹。冒泡、归并、快排各带两个写法，可并排对照。

desc.en: Eleven programs on graphs, each stored as a dictionary of neighbour lists or as an adjacency matrix. It starts with the two representations and converting between them, then breadth-first search - the order it visits nodes in, and shortest paths when every edge counts as one step - and depth-first search twice, recursively and with an explicit stack that visits in exactly the same order. Weighted graphs come next: Dijkstra's algorithm as the table scan from exam answers and with a heapq priority queue, Kahn's topological sort with its cycle check, and the minimum spanning tree by Prim and by Kruskal, where a two-line union-find decides whether an edge would close a cycle. A* search on a grid maze finishes the page.
desc.zh: 十一个程序讲图，图一律存成「结点 → 邻居列表」的字典或邻接矩阵。先讲这两种表示与互转，再讲广度优先搜索——它访问结点的顺序，以及每条边算一步时的最短路——然后是两遍深度优先搜索：递归版，与访问顺序完全相同的显式栈版。接着是带权图：Dijkstra 算法的考卷扫表版与 heapq 优先队列版，带环检测的 Kahn 拓扑排序，Prim 与 Kruskal 两种最小生成树——Kruskal 里用两行并查集判断一条边会不会成环。最后是网格迷宫上的 A* 搜索。

tag.en: BFS · DFS · Dijkstra · topological sort · MST · union-find · A* · read / fill in / trace
tag.zh: 广度优先 · 深度优先 · Dijkstra · 拓扑排序 · 最小生成树 · 并查集 · A* · 读 / 挖空 / 临摹

changelog.en: First release: eleven graph programs with all three modes - read, fill in the blanks, and shadow tracing. Depth-first search, Dijkstra and the minimum spanning tree each come in two variants for side-by-side comparison.
changelog.zh: 首发：十一个图算法程序，三种模式全开——读、挖空、影子临摹。深度优先搜索、Dijkstra 与最小生成树各带两个写法，可并排对照。

desc.en: Ten programs on two ways of building an answer step by step. Dynamic programming first: counting paths across a grid with blocked cells top-down with lru_cache and bottom-up in a table; the 0/1 knapsack as a two-dimensional table and as a single row that must be walked from high to low; the longest common subsequence, with a walk back through the table to recover one; and edit distance. Then greedy algorithms, and when they can be trusted: coin change by always taking the biggest coin, which is optimal for UK coins but not for every coin set, set beside coin change by dynamic programming; activity selection by earliest finishing time, with the two tempting rules that fail; and the total length of a Huffman code, merging the two rarest groups with heapq.
desc.zh: 十个程序，讲一步步搭出答案的两种办法。先是动态规划：带障碍网格的路径数，用 lru_cache 自顶向下、用一张表自底向上；0/1 背包的二维表，以及必须从大到小遍历的一维滚动数组；最长公共子序列，再在表里倒着走出一条；编辑距离。然后是贪心，以及什么时候能信它：每次拿最大面值的找零——对英镑硬币最优、换一套硬币就未必，与动态规划的找零并排；按最早结束时间的活动选择，以及两条看似合理却会出错的规则；用 heapq 反复合并最少见的两组，算出 Huffman 编码的总位数。

tag.en: dynamic programming · memoisation · tables · knapsack · LCS · edit distance · greedy · Huffman · read / fill in / trace
tag.zh: 动态规划 · 记忆化 · 填表 · 背包 · LCS · 编辑距离 · 贪心 · Huffman · 读 / 挖空 / 临摹

changelog.en: First release: ten dynamic-programming and greedy programs with all three modes - read, fill in the blanks, and shadow tracing. Grid paths, the 0/1 knapsack and coin change each come in two variants for side-by-side comparison.
changelog.zh: 首发：十个动态规划与贪心程序，三种模式全开——读、挖空、影子临摹。网格路径、0/1 背包与找零各带两个写法，可并排对照。

desc.en: Twelve programs about how the work an algorithm does grows with the size of its input - measured by counting steps, never by timing. Four loop shapes counted side by side; a table of log n, n, n log n, n squared and 2 to the n; linear and binary search with a comparison counter; insertion sort whose shift count turns out to be the number of out-of-order pairs; merge sort against insertion sort on the same input; and the doubling experiment, which reads the order of growth off the ratio of two counts. Two problems are then solved three ways each, in O(n^2), O(n log n) and O(n): does a list have a duplicate, and what is the largest sum of a run of neighbours.
desc.zh: 十二个程序，讲算法的工作量怎样随输入规模增长——靠数步数来量，从不计时。四种循环形状并排数一数；log n、n、n log n、n 平方、2 的 n 次方的增长表；带比较计数器的线性查找与二分查找；插入排序的右移次数原来就是逆序对的个数；同一份输入上归并排序对插入排序；还有倍增实验——从两次计数之比读出增长的阶。最后两个问题各用三种写法、分别是 O(n^2)、O(n log n)、O(n)：列表里有没有重复，以及相邻元素组成的一段最大能加到多少。

tag.en: Big O · step counting · growth rates · doubling experiment · has duplicates · maximum subarray · read / fill in / trace
tag.zh: 大 O · 数步数 · 增长率 · 倍增实验 · 有没有重复 · 最大子段和 · 读 / 挖空 / 临摹

changelog.en: First release: twelve complexity programs with all three modes - read, fill in the blanks, and shadow tracing. Has-duplicates and maximum-subarray each come in three variants of different complexity, for side-by-side comparison.
changelog.zh: 首发：十二个复杂度程序，三种模式全开——读、挖空、影子临摹。「有没有重复」与「最大子段和」各带三个复杂度不同的写法，可并排对照。

desc.en: Twelve programs that imitate a random or rule-driven process and measure what comes out. Every random number is made by a seeded generator in the driver and handed to a plain function, so the logic can be checked on its own. Pi estimated with random points and on a regular grid; two dice against their exact chances; a random walk and gambler's ruin; a single-server queue whose waits explode as the till gets busy; the Game of Life on a bounded table and on an unbounded set; an SIR epidemic that must update all at once; a traffic light as a finite state machine; and the Fisher-Yates shuffle beside a naive one that is provably biased.
desc.zh: 十二个程序，模仿一个随机的或按规则运转的过程，再量出结果。每个随机数都由驱动里带种子的生成器造出、交给一个普通函数，于是逻辑本身可以单独检验。随机撒点与规则网格估 π；两颗骰子对精确概率；随机游走与赌徒破产；柜台越忙、等待越暴涨的单服务台排队；在有界二维表与无界集合上的生命游戏；必须同时更新的 SIR 传染病模型；写成有限状态机的交通灯；还有 Fisher-Yates 洗牌，以及一个可以证明有偏的天真洗牌。

tag.en: Monte Carlo · random walks · queues · Game of Life · state machine · shuffling · read / fill in / trace
tag.zh: 蒙特卡洛 · 随机游走 · 排队 · 生命游戏 · 状态机 · 洗牌 · 读 / 挖空 / 临摹

changelog.en: First release: twelve simulation programs with all three modes - read, fill in the blanks, and shadow tracing. Estimating pi, the Game of Life and shuffling each come in two variants for side-by-side comparison.
changelog.zh: 首发：十二个模拟程序，三种模式全开——读、挖空、影子临摹。「估 π」「生命游戏」「洗牌」各带两个写法，可并排对照。

desc.en: Twelve programs that are small games, each keeping the rules in pure functions and the reading and printing in a loop around them. Tic-tac-toe is checked for a winner two ways - a table of the eight lines, and loops over rows and columns - then played by two people through a game loop written as a state machine, then solved with minimax. The computer guesses your number by halving the range; hangman hides the letters you have not found. The 2048 row rule is written two ways and then reused for all four directions of the board. A minesweeper field is laid with a seeded random generator and opened with a breadth-first flood, and two Pig dice strategies play a thousand games against each other.
desc.zh: 十二个小游戏程序，规则都放在纯函数里，读输入与打印放在外面的循环里。井字棋判胜两种写法——八条赢线表、按行按列的循环——再用写成状态机的游戏循环让两个人对下，最后用极小化极大求解。电脑用折半猜你心里的数；Hangman 把没猜到的字母遮住。2048 的一行规则写两种，再复用到整盘的四个方向。扫雷用带种子的随机数生成器布雷、用广度优先连片翻开；Pig 骰子的两种策略对打一千局。

tag.en: tic-tac-toe · minimax · game loop · halving · hangman · 2048 · minesweeper · Pig dice · read / fill in / trace
tag.zh: 井字棋 · 极小化极大 · 游戏循环 · 折半猜数 · Hangman · 2048 · 扫雷 · Pig 骰子 · 读 / 挖空 / 临摹

changelog.en: First release: twelve game programs with all three modes - read, fill in the blanks, and shadow tracing. The tic-tac-toe winner test and the 2048 row rule each come in two variants for side-by-side comparison.
changelog.zh: 首发：十二个游戏程序，三种模式全开——读、挖空、影子临摹。井字棋判胜与 2048 一行规则各带两个写法，可并排对照。

desc.en: Twelve programs about working with real text and data. Clean text before comparing it; count the most common words in a file, with stopwords and a tie rule; then a first course in regular expressions - findall and quantifiers, fullmatch for validation, groups and re.sub, and named groups for parsing a log file. JSON goes out to a file and back, and gets dug into key by key; a small parser reads a settings file with sections and comments; and a tokeniser cuts an arithmetic expression into tokens. Two problems come in a regex version and a by-hand version side by side: checking a date's format, and tokenising.
desc.zh: 十二个程序，讲怎样处理真实的文本与数据。先清洗再比较；从文件里数出最常见的词，带停用词与并列规则；然后是正则表达式入门——findall 与量词、用 fullmatch 做校验、分组与 re.sub、用命名分组解析日志文件。JSON 写进文件再读回来，并按键一层层取值；一个小解析器读带节与注释的配置文件；一个记号切分器把算术表达式切成记号。两个问题各有正则版与手工版并排对照：校验日期格式，以及切记号。

tag.en: text cleaning · word frequency · regular expressions · JSON · parsing · tokeniser · read / fill in / trace
tag.zh: 文本清洗 · 词频 · 正则表达式 · JSON · 解析 · 记号切分 · 读 / 挖空 / 临摹

changelog.en: First release: twelve text-and-data programs with all three modes - read, fill in the blanks, and shadow tracing. Date checking and tokenising each come in a regex version and a by-hand version, for side-by-side comparison.
changelog.zh: 首发：十二个文本与数据程序，三种模式全开——读、挖空、影子临摹。「校验日期」与「切记号」各有正则版与手工版，可并排对照。

desc.en: Eleven programs that put classes, exceptions, files, JSON and CSV together into small working systems. A gradebook where two classes split the work, then saved as JSON and loaded back as equal objects; stock control with a dataclass and an out-of-stock exception, then restocked in bulk from a CSV file with the bad rows reported by line number; a bank transfer that checks everything before changing anything; library loans with a limit and fines; competition ranking with shared places; money kept in whole pence and done again with Decimal; a menu-driven program; and a table of normal, boundary and erroneous test data that catches an off-by-one bug.
desc.zh: 十一个程序，把类、异常、文件、JSON、CSV 合起来做成能用的小系统。两个类分工的成绩册，再存成 JSON、读回相等的对象；用数据类和缺货异常管库存，再按 CSV 文件批量进货、坏行按行号报出；先全部检查再动手的转账；有上限和罚金的图书馆借还；同分同名次的比赛排名；钱用整数便士存、再用 Decimal 算一遍；菜单驱动的程序；以及一张正常、边界、错误三类测试数据表，抓住一个差一错误。

tag.en: classes working together · JSON persistence · CSV batch · atomic transfer · money in pence / Decimal · test data · read / fill in / trace
tag.zh: 类的协作 · JSON 持久化 · CSV 批处理 · 原子转账 · 便士 / Decimal · 测试数据 · 读 / 挖空 / 临摹

changelog.en: First release: eleven small-system programs with all three modes - read, fill in the blanks, and shadow tracing. Money in whole pence and money with Decimal form a variant pair for side-by-side comparison.
changelog.zh: 首发：十一个小型系统程序，三种模式全开——读、挖空、影子临摹。「钱用整数便士存」与「钱用 Decimal 算」是一组变体，可并排对照。

desc.en: Ten programs of introductory statistics with NumPy and the statistics module. Three kinds of average and a median written by hand; the standard deviation divided by n or by n - 1, and z-scores that pick out an outlier; Pearson's r from its definition and from np.corrcoef, with a U-shaped curve that hides behind r = 0 and a correlation that is not a cause; the line of best fit from its formula and from np.polyfit, with residuals and an extrapolation that goes wrong; thousands of simulated samples whose means spread like sigma over root n; normal probabilities with NormalDist; a one-sample z-test with a p-value, and a t statistic compared with a table value.
desc.zh: 十个统计入门程序，用 NumPy 与 statistics 模块。三种平均与手写的中位数；标准差除以 n 还是 n - 1，以及挑出离群值的 z 分数；照定义与用 np.corrcoef 求皮尔逊 r，一条躲在 r = 0 后面的 U 形曲线、一个不是因果的相关；照公式与用 np.polyfit 求最佳拟合直线，看残差和一次出错的外推；几千组模拟样本，均值按 σ / √n 散布；用 NormalDist 求正态概率；带 p 值的单样本 z 检验，以及与查表值比较的 t 统计量。

tag.en: mean / median / mode · standard deviation · correlation · regression · sampling · normal distribution · z-test / t statistic · read / fill in / trace
tag.zh: 平均数 / 中位数 / 众数 · 标准差 · 相关 · 回归 · 抽样 · 正态分布 · z 检验 / t 统计量 · 读 / 挖空 / 临摹

changelog.en: First release: ten introductory statistics programs with all three modes - read, fill in the blanks, and shadow tracing. Pearson's r and the line of best fit each come as a variant pair (by the formula / with a library call) for side-by-side comparison.
changelog.zh: 首发：十个统计入门程序，三种模式全开——读、挖空、影子临摹。皮尔逊 r 与最佳拟合直线各是一组变体（照公式 / 库函数），可并排对照。
